name: SK Discovery Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1969 and based in Seongnam-si, South Korea, SK Discovery Co., Ltd. operates a diverse range of businesses both domestically and internationally through its various subsidiaries. The company specializes in the development and supply of environmentally conscious materials, including biomaterials, advanced composites, high-performance substances, and energy-efficient solutions. It also plays a significant role in public health by providing healthcare solutions, such as vaccines and pharmaceuticals, for the treatment, prevention, and diagnosis of diseases. Furthermore, SK Discovery's portfolio extends to the energy and chemicals sector, encompassing the management of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) storage, the operation of tank terminals, and power generation. Its real estate division is responsible for developing a variety of properties, including commercial spaces, office buildings, urban and high-end residential complexes, as well as infrastructure for renewable energy, such as solar and wind power plants. The company adopted its current name, SK Discovery Co., Ltd., in December 2017, having previously been known as SK Chemicals Co., Ltd.
